reviewed_safety: Kernel-advertised frequency and existing userspace governor/limits are checked; no governor/CPU/voltage/driver changes.
Every saved running observation must equal requested frequency; a mismatch is recorded before failure/worker stop/restore.
All seven initial thermal nodes remain required; unreadable nodes stop the run, temperature limit is at most 75 C, timeout at most 180 s.
Saved PGID cleanup applies after leader exit; TERM and KILL group polls are bounded before restoring frequency.
Repeated termination signals are ignored during finally cleanup; restore errors cannot yield a successful status.
Original actual frequency/governor/min/max are restored and checked; undefined userspace request is explicitly converted to the original measured frequency.
New complete/replay launchers retain original retained aggregator/grouped DINO/camera split4/depth/half IO/cache/pageout settings, with fixed manifest hashes and fresh output directories.
limits: Clock evidence consists of sampled observations; intervals between samples are not continuously instrumented.
Restoration verification is one final sampled read; abrupt power loss or SIGKILL cannot execute Python finally.
These source/fake checks do not establish actual-board speed, trajectory quality, stability or physical-memory acceptance.
